items.title: FBI, CISA warn of cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems
items.summary: The FBI and CISA warn that hackers are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems worldwide, potentially causing food spoilage, equipment damage, and fire hazards. [...]

items.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
items.summary: Hackers are using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to lure employees into phishing attacks, using two different phishing-as-a-service platforms to steal Microsoft and Google account credentials and authentication sessions. [...]

items.title: Nearly 1.5 million exposed secrets targeted in new revocation program
items.summary: Truffle Security has launched the Secrets Revocation Program, a free initiative that helps API key issuers revoke 1.4 million publicly exposed secrets that remain valid. [...]

items.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra silently obstructed safety research tasks
items.summary: OpenAI has disclosed another AI alignment incident where GPT-6 Astra was found to sometimes quietly withhold help on safety research. [...]

items.title: OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Linux accounts
items.summary: A newly disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability dubbed "*sshole" allows attackers to log in to certain Alpine Linux and other musl-based Linux accounts that are configured to block password authentication, simply by entering an oversized password. [...]

items.title: Hackers backdoor Linux servers using trojanized CWP web server
items.summary: A new Linux malware called CWPdoor is being distributed through a trojanized version of cwpsrv, the web server behind the Control Web Panel (CWP) management interface. [...]

items.title: DigiCert data breach exposes customer information, identity documents
items.summary: DigiCert warns it suffered a data breach after a server migration mistakenly exposed an internal business system to the internet, allowing unauthorized access to customer information and identity documents. [...]

items.title: Closing the Identity Gap at the Service Desk
items.summary: Attackers target IT service desks to bypass MFA by impersonating employees and convincing staff to reset passwords or register new authentication devices. Specops Software explains why traditional identity verification methods are no longer sufficient and how organizations can secure account recovery against social engineering risks. [...]

items.title: GhostMap Android flaw lets malicious app trigger persistent boot loop
items.summary: Attackers can force Android devices into a continuous boot loop using a specially crafted app that requires no permissions and only needs to be installed. [...]

items.title: Vercel rolls out new protection against stolen session cookie attacks
items.summary: Vercel is gradually rolling out Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) on its platform as a key defense against information stealer malware. [...]

items.title: Zyxel fixes zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches
items.summary: Zyxel has patched a zero-day vulnerability in its GS1900 series network switches that hackers exploited to compromise nearly 1,000 devices worldwide and steal configuration files and credentials. [...]

items.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
items.summary: DreamHost is warning of a data breach after attackers gained access to its File Manager platform for two months and stole customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. [...]

items.title: Cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France
items.summary: France's national blood service has confirmed that a cyberattack targeting a refrigeration equipment provider raised temperature and defrost settings at three of its facilities, threatening stored blood products. [...]

items.title: NIKKE PC game launcher hacked to spread remote access, data-stealing malware
items.summary: The developers of Goddess of Victory: NIKKE have confirmed that hackers tampered with the game's PC launcher scripts in a supply-chain attack, distributing malware capable of stealing credentials and cryptocurrency wallet data. [...]

items.title: mSecure password manager hack prompts password reset warnings
items.summary: mSeven Software is warning current and former mSecure password manager customers to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys following a cyberattack that reportedly exposed an encrypted customer database. [...]
